records.scope: Site-specific hazards; ASCE 41 selections are seismic only.

parameters.name: wind
parameters.meaning: Three-second gust speed, Exposure C, at 33 ft (10 m) elevation above ground
parameters.units: Tool offers customary/SI; preserve units from each individual report.

parameters.name: snow
parameters.meaning: Ground snow load; edition-specific meaning and design basis must accompany each site result
parameters.units: Not assigned until a specific report is captured.

parameters.name: rain
parameters.meaning: Rainfall intensities; source identifies NOAA HDSC data for ASCE 7-16/7-22
parameters.units: Not assigned until a specific report is captured.

records.access: Public site queries described as free; API quote offered separately.
records.gap: No bulk dataset, API agreement, source-byte hashes or redistribution rights acquired. No site values harvested.

limitations: NBCC Ss/Sr are not mapped to ASCE parameters.
No Canadian values or invented coordinates reused.
Do not attach climate values to population centroids or Census representative points without project/site validation.
